text: The future of AI is exciting but uncertain. Today, we have "narrow" AI that can do one task, like translating languages. Experts are now working on Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), a machine that can think and learn like a human. AGI could bring amazing benefits, such as solving diseases or climate change. However, there are also serious risks, including job loss and safety concerns. When will AGI arrive? Some predict it in 20 years, while others say it may take much longer. We must discuss these issues carefully to ensure AI helps everyone.
